description: Owns the task-specific warehouse-network requirement profile, input gaps, readiness checklist and smallest deterministic analysis without geography defaults.
responsibilities: Translate the user's planning goal into a versioned data_requirement_profile.v1 and continue without a separate Profile confirmation.
Consume only published Workspace evidence and preserve synthetic Demo provenance when present.
Evaluate current coverage and cost, then solve the finite candidate set only when the published Profile requests optimization.
Publish typed network, map and report Resources with explicit assumptions and no geography defaults.
risks: Results are exact only for the finite candidates, assignments, capacities, rates and route facts that are explicitly confirmed where required.
Estimated routes are planning approximations, not navigation promises.
